verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms Mastra ships its own MCP client that can consume external MCP servers, but only stdio servers were supported (not SSE), so the user needed a proxy. The server-side MCP claim (mastra-docs-20) is a different role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the MCP client and tool consumption, native SSE/HTTP transport support, and independent corroboration of current capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: A user notes only stdio MCP servers were supported by Mastra's MCP client, not SSE.
